extracted.name: Heavenly Hash
extracted.description: A heavenly pink concoction made with rice, pineapples, marshmallows and whipped cream.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup confectioners' sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: In a saucepan bring water to a boil. Add rice and stir. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Cool completely.

In a large bowl, combine rice, pineapple, marshmallows, cherries and about 1 tablespoon cherry juice. In a chilled bowl, whip the cream until peaks form. Fold in confectioners sugar. Fold whipped cream into rice mixture. Refrigerate for 2 hours.
